name: smwgraphics-custom-ninji-giant-ninji-sideways-ninji-and-giant-sideways-ninji
title: Custom Ninji, Giant Ninji, Sideways Ninji and Giant Sideways Ninji
description:
Original graphic replacements for the following sprites:

  • Ninji (sprite 51)
  • Sideways Ninji
  • Giant Ninji
  • Giant Sideways Ninji

As well as any custom sprite that uses the original Ninji graphics.

In addition to the graphics, the .zip comes with a custom palette for a purple Ninji skin, akin to the enemy's appearance in SMAS:SMB2. Required to set the sprites' palette through STEAR/Tweaker/PIXI's CFG Editor from palette C to palette F for the color change to take effect.

Additional information in the readme file. Credit is optional, but appreciated.
